name: @cpeople/db
description: Prisma schema, migrations, row-level-security policies and seed for CPeople

scripts.migrate: cross-env CPEOPLE_LOCAL_DEV=true prisma migrate dev && pnpm run local-role
scripts.migrate:deploy: cross-env CPEOPLE_LOCAL_DEV=true prisma migrate deploy && pnpm run local-role
scripts.migrate:reset: cross-env CPEOPLE_LOCAL_DEV=true prisma migrate reset && pnpm run local-role
scripts.seed: pnpm run build && cross-env CPEOPLE_LOCAL_DEV=true node dist/seed.js
scripts.test: prisma generate && cross-env CPEOPLE_LOCAL_DEV=true vitest run
